q1.explanationZh: wake up 意为“醒来；叫醒”，叫醒某人时代词放中间：wake me up。

q2.explanationZh: tour guide“导游”，tour 是“旅行，旅游”，guide 是“向导”。

q3.explanationZh: with the help of sb./sth.“在……的帮助下”，介词用 with，help 前要有 the。

q4.explanationZh: think of“想起；想到”；What do you think of…? 意为“你觉得……怎么样？”。

q5.explanationZh: wait 是不及物动词，“等某人/某物”要加 for：wait for sb./sth.。

q6.explanationZh: the week after next 字面是“下周之后的那一周”，即“下下周”；前面不加介词。

q7.explanationZh: work out“做出；算出；制定出”，宾语是代词时放中间：work it out。

q8.explanationZh: to one’s joy/surprise“使某人高兴/惊奇的是”，常放在句首，one’s 换成具体的物主代词，如 To my surprise。

q9.explanationZh: worry about sb./sth.“为……而担心”，worry 是动词；也可以说 be worried about。

q10.explanationZh: with great care“非常小心地”，相当于 very carefully，修饰动作。

q11.explanationZh: try on“试穿”，宾语是代词时放中间：try it on。

q12.explanationZh: the same…as“与……同样”，the same 后可接名词，如 the same price as。

q13.explanationZh: used to do sth.“过去常常做某事”（现在不再这样），to 后接动词原形。

q14.explanationZh: with pleasure“愉快地；乐意”，回答别人的请求时也可以单独说 With pleasure.

q15.explanationZh: too + 形容词/副词 + to do“太……以至不能……”，句子没有 not 却表示否定意思。

q16.explanationZh: think about“考虑（做某事是否可行）”，如 think about your suggestion。

q17.explanationZh: turn out“结果是；证明是”，常用 turn out to be… 或 It turns out that…。

q18.explanationZh: what’s more“而且；另外”，用来补充更进一步的理由，常放句首并加逗号。

q19.explanationZh: talk about sth.“谈到；谈论某事”，about 后接谈论的内容。

q20.explanationZh: throw away“扔掉”，宾语是代词时放中间：throw it away。

q21.explanationZh: turn over“翻过来；翻身；翻（页）”，over 表示“翻转过来”。

q22.explanationZh: tell A from B“区别 A 和 B”，这里 tell 的意思是“分辨”，不是“告诉”。

q23.explanationZh: would like/love (to do)“想要；很想（做）”，语气比 want 委婉，to 后接动词原形。

q24.explanationZh: turn on“打开（电器）”，反义词组是 turn off（关掉）。

q25.explanationZh: think over“仔细考虑”，宾语是代词时放中间：think it over。

q26.explanationZh: “取代；代替某人”= take the place of sb.；will 后用动词原形 take。

q27.explanationZh: “开始从事（某项爱好）”= take up；说的是她 60 多岁时的事，用过去式 took up。

q28.explanationZh: “与某人谈话”= talk to/with sb.；like to 后用动词原形，后半句也用了 talk with。

q29.explanationZh: “区别；分辨”= tell A from B，把 her 放在 tell 和 from 中间；can 后用动词原形 tell。

q30.explanationZh: “过去常常”= used to do，后面接动词原形 ride；but now 说明现在不这样了。

q31.explanationZh: “等待”= wait for；had to 后用动词原形 wait。

q32.explanationZh: “在……的帮助下”= with the help of，后接帮助的人或工具：with the help of a dictionary。

q33.explanationZh: 太吵了，要把音量“调低”= turn down；这是祈使句，动词原形开头，句首字母大写。

q34.explanationZh: “宁愿”= would rather，后接动词原形 use。

q35.explanationZh: “变成”= turn into；楼房是“被改造成”图书馆，用一般过去时的被动语态 was turned into。

q36.sampleAnswer: It is wrong to tell a lie.
references: It is wrong to tell a lie.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “做某事是不对的”= It is wrong to do sth.，it 是形式主语；“撒谎”= tell a lie。

q37.sampleAnswer: I will help you with pleasure.
references: I will help you with pleasure.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “很乐意地”= with pleasure，放在句末修饰 help you。

q38.sampleAnswer: I will think about your suggestion.
references: I will think about your suggestion.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “考虑某事”= think about sth.；“会”表示将来，用 will。

q39.sampleAnswer: You must use this instrument with great care.
references: You must use this instrument with great care.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: 英语里要补出主语 you：You must use…；“格外小心地”= with great care，放在句末。

q40.sampleAnswer: What’s more, we became good friends.
references: What’s more, we became good friends.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “而且”= What’s more，放句首加逗号；“变成了”是过去的事，用 became。

q41.sampleAnswer: To my surprise, he could work out the problem alone.
references: To my surprise, he could work out the problem alone.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “令我吃惊的是”= To my surprise，one’s 换成 my；“解决问题”可用 work out the problem。

q42.sampleAnswer: With the help of them, we could finish the work in time.
references: With the help of them, we could finish the work in time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “在他们的帮助下”= With the help of them，放句首；“能够”用 could。

q43.sampleAnswer: I would rather fail than cheat in the examination.
references: I would rather fail than cheat in the examination.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “宁愿做 A 也不做 B”= would rather do A than do B，rather 和 than 后面都用动词原形。

q44.sampleAnswer: I will think about your suggestion.
references: I will think about your suggestion.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: 和第 3 题相同：“考虑某事”= think about sth.，“会”用 will。

q45.sampleAnswer: The maths problem was so difficult that nobody could work it out.
references: The maths problem was so difficult that nobody could work it out.
The maths problem wasn’t easy enough for anybody to work out.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “太……以至于……”可用 so…that…；“解答出来”= work out，代词 it 放在 work 和 out 中间。
